meta.source: Brand Guidelines v1.0, Brand and component system v1, greamhq.com landing page code; conflicts resolved in v1.1 (November 2026)

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Ledger Green. Text on light grounds, dark sections, the logo. About 30% of a layout.

tokens.name: green-raised
tokens.usage: Hover and raised cards on Ledger Green. Replaces #1a3d33.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Page ground on screen. About 60% of a layout with sage and paper.

tokens.name: mist-deep
tokens.usage: Row and card hover on mist. Replaces #e6ede9, #e9eeea, #e9edea.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Panels, alternate sections, table stripes.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Cards, fields and every printed document.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Input grounds, table header cells, tinted panels. Replaces #f5f7f4, #fbfcfa.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body. Running text on mist, sage, paper (8.6:1 on mist).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Moss Grey. Labels, captions, hints (6.8:1 on mist). Replaces #5c6862.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and borders on light grounds. 0.5pt in print.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Heavy rule: 1.5pt above totals and under page headers; 2px on screen.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Vermilion. Main action fill, one per view. About 10% of a layout. Text on it is always paper #ffffff (4.88:1), never mist (4.37:1 fails).

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover (6.6:1 with white).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Vermilion Text. Accent words, links, eyebrows on mist, sage or paper (5.35:1 on mist).

tokens.name: accent-on-dark
tokens.usage: Coral. Accent text and eyebrows on Ledger Green (6.28:1).

tokens.name: text-on-dark
tokens.usage: Body and captions on Ledger Green (8.4:1). Replaces #b9c7bf, #c2cfc8, #a0b2a8.

tokens.name: label-on-dark
tokens.usage: Mono labels and table heads on Ledger Green (5.9:1).

tokens.name: ink-on-dark
tokens.usage: Headings and strong text on Ledger Green. Same value as mist.

tokens.name: line-on-dark
tokens.usage: Hairlines on Ledger Green.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px, 3px offset. 4.4:1 on mist, 3.1:1 on green.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Field errors and error messages only (6.8:1 on mist). Not a status colour.

tokens.name: error-ground
tokens.usage: Ground of a field in error.

tokens.name: status-new-fg
tokens.usage: Status text: New, Sent (9.8:1 on its ground).

tokens.name: status-new-bg
tokens.usage: Status ground: New, Sent.

tokens.name: status-neutral-fg
tokens.usage: Status text: Draft, Scheduled, Assigned, Automatic (6.4:1).

tokens.name: status-neutral-bg
tokens.usage: Status ground: neutral family.

tokens.name: status-due-fg
tokens.usage: Status text: Due, Due today, Part paid (5.7:1).

tokens.name: status-due-bg
tokens.usage: Status ground: amber family.

tokens.name: status-overdue-fg
tokens.usage: Status text: Overdue (7.2:1).

tokens.name: status-overdue-bg
tokens.usage: Status ground: Overdue.

tokens.name: status-paid-fg
tokens.usage: Status text: Paid, Done (6.6:1).

tokens.name: status-paid-bg
tokens.usage: Status ground: Paid, Done.

tokens.name: note-paper
tokens.usage: Sticky-note illustration only, on the website problem cards.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Stop losing customers between enquiry and payment.
styles.usage: Hero and final call to action. Fluid 48 to 100px. One per page.

styles.name: section
styles.sample: A clearer process from first contact to payment.
styles.usage: Section headings. Fluid 40 to 70px. Italic words in accent-text (coral on green).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Panel, step, FAQ and email titles. 28 to 34px.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Every enquiry is a potential customer.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a heading. Fluid 18 to 21px, max 620px wide.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We read your answers before we speak.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Card body, table cells, list items. Replaces 14.5, 15.5 and 16.5px.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions, hints, fine print. Replaces 13, 14 and 14.5px. Minimum for sans text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase field names, eyebrows, table heads, steps. 11 to 13px. Replaces 10.5, 11, 12 and 12.5px.

styles.name: doc-label
styles.usage: 7.5pt Arial Bold caps, tracked. Field names and sections.

styles.name: doc-footer
styles.usage: 7.5pt Arial. Company details, Page X of Y.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text, tag padding. Tight UI only.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside chips and button groups.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons, list items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Field padding, small card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gaps. Replaces 20, 22, 26 and 28px.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Panel padding, heading to body. Replaces 30, 34, 36 and 40px.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gutters on desktop, block gaps. Replaces 44 and 56px.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Section head to content, column gaps. Replaces 64 and 80px.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Wide column gaps, hero padding. Replaces 88 (desktop) and 112px.

tokens.name: space-34
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop. Replaces 120 and 152px.

tokens.name: space-section-phone
tokens.usage: Section padding at 760px and below.

tokens.name: gutter-phone
tokens.usage: Page gutter at 760px and below.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, fields, tags, cards, panels. Square is the brand.

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: Chat bubble illustrations only.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Step balls, timeline nodes, icon discs.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The one raised card per page (the business check form). Elsewhere use hairlines, not shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-note
tokens.usage: Sticky-note illustration.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Content column, centred, with 48px gutters.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Standard button height.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of anything clickable, everywhere.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Sticky nav; 64px on phones. Also scroll-margin-top for sections.

tokens.name: mark-min
tokens.usage: Smallest the mark alone may appear on screen (6mm in print). Resolves 24 vs 26px.

tokens.name: mark-nav
tokens.usage: Mark size in the website nav.

tokens.name: logo-min
tokens.usage: Smallest full logo width on screen (30mm in print).

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Icon grid.

tokens.name: icon-stroke
tokens.usage: Every line icon, square ends.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline on screen; 0.5pt in print.

tokens.name: breakpoint-tablet
tokens.usage: Container query: two columns become one.

tokens.name: breakpoint-phone
tokens.usage: Container query: phone layout, sticky bottom bar.
